name: flush_and_reset_stream_state
description: Checks a state byte in the structure and, when it is set, recursively processes the pending sub-entries chosen by its flag bits and combines their results. It then clears the structure's three 32-bit fields and the state byte and returns the combined value.

name: write_parameter_byte_to_buffer
description: Writes one byte from the parameter into a buffer structure after checking its error flag and running an optional flush through a helper. Single-byte mode sends the byte through a helper call, and a failed write sets the error flag, resets the buffer and returns all ones.

name: write_global_byte_to_buffer
description: Writes a byte taken from a global structure into a buffer, flushing it through a helper first when it is already in use. A buffer with no write pointer gets one, a single-byte buffer sends the byte through a helper, and a failed write marks the buffer in error and returns minus one.

name: write_byte_or_close_buffer
description: When a global channel value is minus one it clears the buffer state and returns zero. Otherwise it prepares the write pointer if needed and stores the byte directly, or through a helper in single-byte mode, returning the byte or minus one on failure.

name: write_byte_with_helper_fallback
description: Prepares the buffer's write pointer when it is empty, then stores the byte directly or, in single-byte mode, through a helper call, and returns the byte written. A failed helper call marks the buffer in error and returns all ones.

name: write_byte_advancing_buffer_pointer
description: Resets the buffer's write pointer to its base, sets its end pointer from the stored length and marks the buffer as in use. It then writes the byte from the parameter structure at the write position and returns that byte.

name: find_free_record_slot
description: Scans a fixed table of 22-byte records for one whose in-use byte is zero. The first free record has its three header fields cleared and is returned, or null is returned when every record is in use.

name: claim_next_free_record
description: Starting at the address in the address register, walks forward through 22-byte records until it finds one not in use. It clears that record's three header fields and returns it, or null when no free record is left before the table end.

name: clear_record_three_longs
description: Zeroes the first three 32-bit fields of the record at the address register and returns.

name: initialize_buffer_record
description: Requests a memory block through a library call. When none is available it sets the record's mode to one and points it at its inline buffer; otherwise it sets a size of 1024, marks the record with a flag bit, stores the block pointer, and sets a second flag bit when a follow-up call succeeds.

name: attach_block_to_buffer_record
description: Sets the record's size to 1024 and marks it with a flag bit, then stores a block pointer taken from the caller's structure. It sets a second flag bit when a follow-up helper call succeeds.

name: free_global_list_nodes
description: Walks the global linked list from its head, releasing each node through a library vector call with the node's stored size plus a fixed header size. It then clears the head pointer and returns zero.

name: traverse_list_and_clear
description: Walks a linked list starting at the address in the address register, calling a library vector routine on each node with its stored size plus a fixed header size. It then clears a global variable and returns zero.

name: allocate_and_link_list_node
description: Requests a block sized for the caller's record plus a header through a library call. On success it stores the caller's value in the block, pushes the block onto a global linked list, and returns the address past the header; on failure it returns null.

name: push_list_node_head
description: Links a node in front of a global list: it stores the current head as the node's link, saves the caller's value in the node's second field, makes the node the new head, and returns the address just past its two-field header.

name: forward_low_word_parameter
description: Passes the low word of its parameter to another routine and then returns, performing no other operation.

name: unlink_and_free_list_node
description: Searches the global list for the node whose data area matches the argument, unlinks it, releases it through a library vector call and returns zero. When no node matches it returns minus one.

name: find_and_unlink_list_node
description: Walks the global list looking for the node named by a structure field, unlinks the match and releases it through a helper call, then returns zero. It returns minus one when the node is not on the list.

name: unlink_node_from_predecessor
description: Unlinks a node from the list after its predecessor, or from the list head when there is no predecessor, then releases it through a helper call and returns zero.

name: pop_list_head_and_release
description: Sets the global list head to the successor of the node in the address register, then calls a helper routine and returns zero.

name: validate_table_entry_and_test
description: Checks that the index in the argument lies within the table and that its entry is set. An invalid index records error code two and returns minus one; otherwise the entry is passed to a helper and the result is one on success or zero on failure.

name: check_entry_is_interactive
description: Looks up the handle stored in the table entry selected by a field of the argument structure and returns whether the library reports that handle as interactive.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without any other action.

name: record_io_error_code
description: Calls a helper with its argument. When that fails, it stores the library's last error code in a global variable and returns minus one; on success it returns zero.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without any other action.

name: inspect_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this 19-instruction routine, so its behaviour is not recovered. It is called from five places and calls two other routines.

name: check_stream_mode_and_call
description: Requires one of the mode bits in the structure to be set; when neither read nor write is allowed it records error code five and returns minus one. Otherwise it calls a helper with arguments taken from the structure and, on failure, records the library's last error code and returns minus one.

name: write_and_record_io_error
description: Calls a helper with the handle and buffer arguments and, when that reports failure, stores the library's last error code and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns the helper's result.

name: no_op_return_stub
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: poll_signal_bit_or_notify
description: Calls a library routine with a zero argument and a mask of 4096, then tests bit twelve of the result. When that bit is set and a global flag is zero, the result is returned; when the flag is non-zero another routine is called and zero is returned.

name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns zero.

name: chain_result_to_output
description: Calls a helper with the address of a global variable and a count of four, passes its result to a write wrapper, and then calls an output wrapper.

name: dispatch_on_flag_then_call
description: Calls the function whose pointer is stored in a global variable when that pointer is non-zero, then calls another routine and returns.

name: conditional_global_dispatch
description: Checks several global values and, when each is set, calls helper routines with arguments drawn from those globals. It also loops over a global count of table entries, invokes a function pointer stored in a global, makes a library call selected by a flag, and returns a saved stack value.

name: close_and_clear_handle_entry
description: Validates a table index, closes the handle held in that entry through the library close routine unless the entry's high flag bit is set, and clears the entry, returning zero. An invalid index records error code two and returns minus one.

name: invoke_close_handler
description: Calls the library close routine through a vector at offset minus 36 from a library base kept in the data area, and returns nothing.

name: call_current_dir_wrapper
description: Calls the library current-directory routine through a vector at offset minus 126 from a library base kept in the data area, and returns nothing.

name: call_open_wrapper
description: Calls the library open routine through a vector at offset minus 30 from a library base kept in the data area, and returns nothing.

name: call_write_wrapper
description: Calls the library write routine through a vector at offset minus 48 from a library base kept in the data area, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_108
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 108 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_414
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 414 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_414
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 414 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_198
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 198 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_198
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 198 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_126
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 126 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_294
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 294 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_132
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 132 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_132
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 132 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_210
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 210 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_210
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 210 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_372
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 372 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_552
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 552 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_378
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 378 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_384
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 384 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: If a destination pointer is supplied, copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset in the data structure into it, then calls the code pointer held in a register.

name: run_structure_setup_sequence
description: Stores values into a supplied buffer and into fields of a structure, making a series of calls through a code pointer. It adjusts a count and a slot in the structure and ends with an indirect jump whose target the decompiler could not recover.

name: walk_index_chain_with_callback
description: Stores the first looked-up table entry into a node, then follows a chain of indexed links, calling a code pointer for each step while the link is non-zero. It ends with an indirect jump whose target the decompiler could not recover.

name: start_program_parse_args
description: Program entry: it allocates a state structure, then either splits the command-line text into quoted or space-separated words or takes the alternative path when no argument buffer exists. It runs setup through library calls, releases its resources and returns a status code.

name: restore_patch_state
description: Stores the parameter into a slot of the current state structure, then calls the cleanup routines held in that structure's table for each field that is set. It returns the saved parameter.

name: run_guarded_patch_chain
description: Calls one routine, then when a global flag is set calls another with its argument and passes the result to a third routine; it ends with a further unconditional call.

name: install_setpatch_handler
description: Records whether any command-line argument was given and checks the first argument for a usage request. It then performs a series of library patches for the exec, layers and trackdisk parts, choosing the variant by OS version, and allocates a block whose fields it then sets.

name: call_patch_vector_46
description: Calls the function stored at a fixed offset of a table pointed to by a global variable and returns the value it produces.

name: call_indirect_via_table
description: Calls a code pointer found at a fixed offset of a table held in a global variable and returns the value the call produces.

name: tail_call_library_vector_132
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 132 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_138
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 138 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_198
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 198 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_294
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 294 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_414
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 414 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: tail_call_library_vector_552
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 552 from the library base kept in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: allocate_and_patch_memory
description: Checks fields of a global structure and, when its conditions are met, obtains a memory block and a code pointer through library calls. It copies a fixed-length code stub into the block, stores the block pointer, computes an inverted checksum over a 22-entry array and returns zero; otherwise it returns a failure code.

name: compute_checksum_and_jump
description: Recomputes the inverted checksum over a 22-entry array in the structure and stores it, then transfers control through a stored pointer. The pointer is first moved by a fixed offset when a marker word is present at its target.

name: disable_interrupts_and_patch
description: Looks up the disk resource through a library call and, when the library version is below 36, sets a global value, toggles a status byte, calls two table routines and stores their results in globals. It then writes to the interrupt-enable register and returns minus one when the patch was applied and zero otherwise.

name: check_flag_and_copy_word
description: Calls a routine through a global pointer and tests its result. When the result is non-zero it copies a 32-bit word from a fixed offset in a global structure into a global variable.

name: call_fallback_on_state_mismatch
description: Returns early when a global value differs from the stored value and is not minus one; otherwise it calls the function pointer held in another global variable.

name: call_fallback_on_minus_one_input
description: Returns immediately unless its input register holds minus one, in which case it calls the function pointer stored in a global variable.

name: write_tag_and_dispatch_handler
description: Writes to the interrupt-enable register and, when a four-byte tag in low memory differs from its expected value, writes the tag and an attribute value there. It then jumps through one of two code pointers chosen by a memory-flag test.

name: tail_call_pointer_136
description: Calls the function pointer stored at a fixed offset of 136 bytes from a global base and returns.

name: initialize_patch_function_table
description: Stores a computed offset into a global variable and then fills sixteen consecutive table entries with successive code addresses.

name: call_stub_chain_return_last
description: Calls a long run of stub routines in sequence and returns the value produced by the final call.

name: call_stub_chain_return_last
description: Calls a long run of stub routines in sequence and returns the value produced by the final call.

name: call_stub_chain_return_last
description: Calls a long run of stub routines in sequence and returns the value produced by the final call.

name: return_input_value
description: Returns the value passed in the data register unchanged, with no other operation.

name: set_exec_function_if_supported
description: Returns without action when a library version field is above 35; otherwise it calls the exec SetFunction vector through the library base.

name: copy_pair_list_with_allocation
description: Allocates a block through a library call and copies a list of entries from the source structure into it, fetching each through a second library call. When one fails it releases the entries already copied and returns a value with the high bit set.

name: release_counted_entries_flagged
description: Calls a library release routine once for each remaining count plus one final call, then returns the value at the address register with its high bit set.

name: release_entry_return_flag
description: Calls a library release routine once, then returns the value at the address register with its high bit set.

name: tail_call_library_vector_30
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 30 from the library base in an address register, and returns nothing.

name: empty_stub_routine
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: call_pointers_if_first_succeeds
description: Calls a function pointer with a value from the parameter structure; when that call succeeds it calls two further pointers, the second with the same value, and returns whether the first call succeeded.

name: scan_for_marker
description: Advances through a list of 16-bit words until it reaches one whose high byte equals 97, and returns the position of that word.

name: advance_past_encoded_record
description: Reads a length from the first word, using its low byte when that is non-zero or a signed second word otherwise, and returns the address just past the record that length describes.

name: compute_word_offset
description: Reads a 16-bit value two bytes past the input pointer, sign-extends it, rounds it to an even count, adds two and returns the input pointer advanced by that amount.

name: patch_global_pointers
description: Calls a helper repeatedly to compute successive addresses from the input pointer and stores each result in one of several global variables.

name: recurse_with_stack_slot
description: Calls another routine with its two parameters and a pointer to a fixed stack location, then returns.

name: measure_and_pass_stack_text
description: Calls a function pointer held in a global variable, then measures the NUL-terminated text in a 140-byte stack buffer and, when it is non-empty, passes the buffer and its length to another routine.
